prompt: John, an IT manager, is configuring an email filter for a user named Anna. Anna wants all emails from "newsletter@example.com" to be moved to a folder named "Newsletters" and no longer appear in her main inbox. Which of the following Sieve actions should John use to achieve this requirement?
explanation: The fileinto action moves a message into the specified folder; since it cancels the implicit keep, the message no longer appears in the inbox.
